title: Brass Band Rehearsal Scheduler Project Board
originalRequest: Design and develop a specialized rehearsal scheduler for a brass band, managing instrumentation, section lists, dynamic rescheduling, rehearsal orders, and venue configurations.
latestMessage: Design and develop a specialized rehearsal scheduler for a brass band, managing instrumentation, section lists, dynamic rescheduling, rehearsal orders, and venue configurations.

steps.title: Requirement Mapping and Database Architecture Design
steps.instruction: Draft the relational schema detailing the core entities: musicians, brass sections (e.g., cornets, horns, baritones, euphoniums, trombones, tubas, percussion), scheduled rehearsals, repertoire selections, and venue metadata. Define constraints for required sections and minimum instrumentation per section.
steps.acceptance: An initial database entity relationship diagram (ERD) defining tables, foreign keys, and indexes for rehearsal schedules.
steps.result: Completed the ERD and relational schema design mapping sections, musicians, rehearsal blocks, and library repertoire titles on the first run.

steps.title: Scaffold Database Migrations
steps.instruction: Generate raw SQL or migration scripts establishing the database structure, matching tables, and core constraints for the rehearsal scheduler database tables.
steps.acceptance: Database migration scripts successfully execute without errors and produce schema mirroring initial design.
steps.result: First migration script failed because of a cyclic dependency in the venue and schedule tables. Resolved constraints and successfully applied migrations on the second attempt.

steps.title: Database Integrity and Constraints Validation
steps.instruction: Verify the newly generated schema constraints, including checks that force every scheduled rehearsal to have a valid venue and prevent orphan section assignments.
steps.acceptance: Verify validation triggers fail appropriately when null values or violation parameters are introduced into database tests.
steps.result: First test suite run uncovered a null-pointer error on member assignments. Corrected the relational mapping and confirmed verification on second attempt.

steps.title: Evaluate Calendar Libraries for Recurring Events
steps.instruction: Research and select a calendar utility library to manage recurrent rehearsals (e.g. weekly rehearsals, sectionals, special events) while avoiding manual calendar entries.
steps.acceptance: Detailed report summarizing potential calendar engines with selected implementation tool.
steps.result: Completed evaluation. Selected the standard rrule library as the most robust option to handle the complex recurrence requirements for weekly rehearsals.

steps.title: Review Synchronization APIs
steps.instruction: Analyze synchronization mechanisms with standard shared calendar utilities to allow automated syncing of scheduled band practices.
steps.acceptance: Recommended synchronization API architecture based on reliability and ease of integration.
steps.result: Initial attempt using raw WebDAV failed performance tests. Successfully transitioned to REST-based sync wrappers during the second evaluation phase.

steps.title: Investigate Conflict Detection Logic
steps.instruction: Evaluate methods to implement real-time schedule conflict resolution for musicians playing in multiple community ensembles or sub-sections.
steps.acceptance: Technically viable architecture pattern documented for immediate detection of resource conflicts.
steps.result: First version was too slow on nested loops. Rewrote logic to query overlapping ranges via interval trees, verifying high performance in the second attempt.

steps.title: Determine Sectional Instrumentation Balancing Rules
steps.instruction: Investigate the logical thresholds for section validation (e.g., minimum of 3 solo cornets, 1 euphonium, 2 tubas) needed to deem a rehearsal viable.
steps.acceptance: Comprehensive ruleset detailing the mathematical limits for instrumentation validation.
steps.result: Documented brass band section balancing rules including required players per part to ensure functional rehearsal quality.

steps.title: Evaluate Venue Booking Integration Interfaces
steps.instruction: Explore accessible booking APIs of public halls or local venues to synchronize scheduled rehearsals with facility availability.
steps.acceptance: Documented mapping guide explaining connectivity with third-party venue scheduling platforms.
steps.result: Identified two standard venue booking API patterns and documented their request-response structures for the development team.

steps.title: Verify Parsing Dependencies
steps.instruction: Test targeted parser dependencies to ensure they parse date formats for rehearsals across multiple system environments.
steps.acceptance: Successful parsing tests utilizing dummy ISO data across test node instances.
steps.result: Validated date parsing dependency compatibility and proved they function correctly in test environments.

steps.title: Clarify Section Categorization Scope
steps.instruction: Owner: Determine if the scheduling engine needs to distinguish between sub-sections (e.g., Solo Cornet versus Repiano Cornet) or keep them grouped as a general Cornet section.
steps.acceptance: Receive explicit client clarification on division of brass band sections.

steps.title: Rehearsal Scheduling System Architecture Specification
steps.instruction: Produce the formal architectural design document for the rehearsal scheduler engine, defining input/output pipelines and APIs.
steps.acceptance: Completed document ready for implementation teams to build endpoints.
steps.result: Generated comprehensive technical specifications file detailing API request-response structures and scheduling flowcharts.

steps.title: Assess Member Authentication Frameworks
steps.instruction: Research robust authentication platforms for band members, securing access levels for regular players, section leaders, and conductors.
steps.acceptance: Authentication recommendations meeting criteria for simplicity and roles security.
steps.result: Recommended NextAuth engine due to robust middleware role-management properties for administrator, conductor, and player tiers.

steps.title: Investigate PDF Repertoire Sheet Export Utilities
steps.instruction: Evaluate server-side PDF generation tools to compile printable rehearsal orders and repertoire lists for section folders.
steps.acceptance: Evaluation document summarizing top node-compatible PDF libraries.
steps.result: Analyzed options and selected PDFKit for high flexibility with page layout margins for music sheets.

steps.title: Implement Member Mock Authentication Services
steps.instruction: Code dummy auth routes and middleware validating member JSON Web Tokens based on their designated section permissions.
steps.acceptance: Mock endpoints return authorization tokens and handle basic access validation.
steps.result: Created mock endpoints that correctly handle user authentication and parse mock credentials.

steps.title: Verify Integration with External Calendar Service
steps.instruction: Validate interface connectivity with dummy external calendars by importing dummy event structures.
steps.acceptance: Mock event payload successfully synced to local scheduling database.
steps.result: Verification blocked: The external sandbox service endpoints returned unauthorized errors. Missing OAuth client secrets on testing environment prevent target communication.

steps.title: Acquire External API Credentials
steps.instruction: Owner: Please provide active credentials, client IDs, and webhook secrets for the target testing calendars.
steps.acceptance: Valid calendar service API keys in environmental storage files.

steps.title: Seed Database with Brass Band Standard Structure
steps.instruction: Build and execute a database seeder script defining the standard 28-piece British brass band configuration.
steps.acceptance: Seeder scripts execute successfully and populate tables with appropriate section hierarchies.
steps.result: Successfully ran seeder scripts populating all core tables with traditional brass band instrumentation and default roles.

steps.title: Verify Database Seed Integrity
steps.instruction: Write automated validation tests checking if seeded data is accessible and holds correct parent-child relationships.
steps.acceptance: Testing checks complete with 100% test success rate.
steps.result: Ran test verification suite confirming standard brass band structure has been successfully established in the local environment.

steps.title: Establish Attendance Quorum Requirements
steps.instruction: Owner: Confirm the minimum overall attendance percentage required to automatically mark a rehearsal as confirmed.
steps.acceptance: An official threshold input (e.g. 60% of total roster) to write into the scheduling generator constraints.

steps.title: Examine Notification Template Libraries
steps.instruction: Examine template-based text/email delivery services to alert band players of emergency schedule revisions or cancellations.
steps.acceptance: A brief selection report detailing the highest scoring templating frameworks.
steps.result: Recommended Handlebars templates combined with node-mailer for simple dynamic mail delivery of schedule alerts.

steps.title: Develop Schedule Generation Engine API Endpoints
steps.instruction: Develop the POST controller endpoints allowing conductors to generate weekly schedules and check for potential conflicts.
steps.acceptance: API accepts date ranges, cross-references conflicts, and returns valid rehearsal schedules.
steps.result: Programmed backend endpoints to generate schedules while automatically screening for section availability conflicts.

steps.title: Verify Schedule Conflict API Endpoints
steps.instruction: Write unit tests to verify conflict engine accurately throws notifications when players are booked for dual rehearsals.
steps.acceptance: Unit tests confirm overlapping reservations are caught and flagged by backend validator.
steps.result: Successfully verified conflict detection logic across multiple test cases. Verified response payloads return accurate conflict arrays.

steps.title: Define Default Schedule Durations
steps.instruction: Owner: Provide the default rehearsal start times and standard durations (e.g. Monday/Thursday 19:30 to 21:30) for schedule generation.
steps.acceptance: Confirmed standard timeframe options to use as configuration defaults.

steps.title: Construct Venue Booking Dashboard UI
steps.instruction: Develop frontend calendar panels displaying current venue reservations and available practice rooms.
steps.acceptance: Interactive web interface displaying daily schedules with clear room booking states.
steps.result: Built and connected the front-end schedule grid view displaying venue occupancies.

steps.title: Build Section Leader RSVP Dashboard
steps.instruction: Program the dashboard interface allowing section leaders to mark attendance estimates for their specific musicians.
steps.acceptance: UI component correctly displays player lists and records RSVP responses.
steps.result: Completed responsive RSVP component, integrating dynamic status icons for confirmed, tentative, and absent musicians.

steps.title: Develop Attendance Logging Database Endpoints
steps.instruction: Program database write actions to record real-time attendance logs during band rehearsals.
steps.acceptance: REST endpoints record attendance data for specific dates and sections.
steps.result: Coded the API controllers to capture and log attendance per player for post-rehearsal analysis.

steps.title: Code Musician Double-Booking Algorithm
steps.instruction: Implement the logic preventing double-booking of shared players (such as percussionists or guest conductors) across different sub-sections on identical dates.
steps.acceptance: Conflict checking algorithm runs on schedule updates and throws error alerts on overlap.
steps.result: Completed double-booking detection logic; integrated checks into reservation updates.

steps.title: Develop Repertoire Timing Scheduler Tool
steps.instruction: Build a schedule division manager allowing conductors to break rehearsals down into specific minutes per piece (e.g., 30 mins march, 45 mins test-piece).
steps.acceptance: Interactive interface calculations update schedule timeline visually as durations are specified.
steps.result: Developed dynamic timing allocator component and associated backend timing API.

steps.title: Develop Conductor Administrative Overrides Panel
steps.instruction: Construct the secure dashboard allowing conductors to manually override scheduling rules, force bookings, or change times.
steps.acceptance: Dashboard view permits administrators to bypass scheduling conflicts after confirmation warnings.
steps.result: Admin override UI panels built and hooked to forced-booking database controllers.

steps.title: Implement Password Reset Module for Band Members
steps.instruction: Create back-to-front authentication flows letting band members securely reset credentials.
steps.acceptance: Secure password recovery system dispatching tokenized reset verification links.
steps.result: Completed password reset flows, secure token generation, and credential update logic.

steps.title: Connect Mobile SMS Notification Gateway
steps.instruction: Configure integration with an SMS dispatcher to broadcast rehearsal update pings directly to players' phones.
steps.acceptance: System successfully triggers alerts via external gateway during test suite execution.
steps.result: Completed integration with standard SMS dispatch API; test alerts route correctly.

steps.title: Optimize Schedule Calculation Queries
steps.instruction: Perform index improvements and rewrite scheduling aggregate queries to improve dashboard load times.
steps.acceptance: Average query times for active schedule dashboards drop under 100 milliseconds.
steps.result: Added composite indexes on rehearsal timing and member status tables. Dashboard load times improved by 50%.

steps.title: Deploy Brass Band Scheduler to Staging
steps.instruction: Compile scheduling application assets and deploy to target staging environment for validation.
steps.acceptance: Publicly accessible test link serving fully operational band scheduling system.
steps.result: Application successfully compiled and deployed to testing sandbox. System behaves normally and is ready for trial.
